title: Sr. Systems Design Architecture Engineer
description:
**What to Expect**

As a member of the Energy Systems Safety Development group, you will be at the forefront of ensuring the safety of Tesla's products across Vehicles, Energy Products, and Robotics. Our team is responsible for simulating extreme real-world scenarios to inform the design of our products, with the goal of leading the industry in handling these conditions.

We're seeking an experienced Engineer to join our team, where you'll investigate complex technical issues, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and inform design decisions to ensure the safety and robustness of Tesla's products.

  
**What You'll Do**

* Study the properties of electrical failures in battery packs and conduct root cause analysis, including scenarios such as short circuit events, and conductive fluids in high voltage systems
* Develop and validate mitigations to identified issues and coordinate interdisciplinary product improvement implementations
* Create experiments to push electrical systems to their limits
* Develop internal standards and processes to continue to improve the safety of our products
* Collaborate in the design and manufacturing of future products

 **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering field, or equivalent experience
* Fundamentals in electrical and thermal properties
* 2+ years’ experience in physically applied-engineering
* Ability to interact across a variety of groups collaboratively
* Practical, hands-on, can-do attitude
* Failure analysis experience a plus
* Lithium ion / automotive / grid scale energy storage experience a plus
* Approximately 5% expected travel

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plan

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Data Center Infrastructure Delivery
description: Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. Role Overview Lambda is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own the integrated delivery program for new data center builds, from the handoff of a selected site by Real Estate through construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and turnover to Network Deployment. You will be the single source of truth for milestones, risks, and dependencies on your sites, leading internal teams and external partners (GCs, design firms, utilities, and vendors) across site work, utilities, shell, MEP, controls, white space, inspections, and commissioning. Ambiguity is high, timelines are compressed, and the stakes are central to company growth. As we scale beyond our first sites, you will help build the playbooks and governance that let us run many concurrent deployments well. What You’ll Do - Own the integrated schedule from site handoff to Operations; break builds into workstreams with clear owners and milestones, and actively manage the critical path and schedule compression. - Drive the delivery sequence from rack requirements to engineering criteria, design, plan set, permitting, construction, commissioning, and turnover for MW-scale, high-density (including liquid-cooled) capacity. - Lead cross-functional execution with Real Estate (site assumptions, fiber, permit path), Energy and Utilities (interconnection, substation, power delivery), Engineering (requirements in the design and plan set), Procurement (long-lead equipment), Construction Management (GC schedule, field progress, inspections), Commissioning (test plans, acceptance), Operations (staffing, procedures, access), and Security

About the Role Lambda's hardware is the product. Every training run, fine-tune, and inference workload our customers launch runs on hardware someone at Lambda decided to buy, configure, and ship as a product. This role owns that decision. You'll manage the GPU (graphics processing unit) fleet lifecycle as a product: new NVIDIA platform introductions such as the B200 and H200 class and the generations that follow, node and cluster configurations, InfiniBand fabric options, and the roadmap for what hardware Lambda offers, when, and at what configuration. You'll sit at the layer where Lambda meets silicon. Externally, you'll work directly with NVIDIA and with ODM (original design manufacturer) partners on roadmap alignment. Internally, you'll work with our data center, supply chain, and infrastructure engineering teams to turn silicon roadmaps into sellable, reliable products: On-Demand GPU Instances, 1-Click Clusters, and our largest multi-node reserved deployments. You'll translate customer demand signals and benchmark data into fleet investment recommendations that shape where Lambda puts its capital. Great product managers at Lambda are defined by three things: insight, influence, and execution.
